reasoning: A classic dog-eared page with two lines of text universally represents a text document, file, form, or written draft. It fits a massive variety of administrative, work, academic, and personal writing tasks, though it competes closely with other generic file and note icons.

pass1.ambiguity: The two thick, even horizontal bars inside the document can look like an equals sign or a pause symbol rather than generic lines of text.
